title: Choose EduMapping's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Metro Line. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Metro Line
options.lineage: Indian metro network maps and station signage (Delhi, Namma, Mumbai)
options.thesis: Every learner rides one line from school to career; rounds are stations, the offer letter is the terminus.
options.viewport: A full-width route diagram: SCHOOL → COLLEGE → PLACEMENT lines in saffron, blue and green, live station dots for each round, the tagline on a station-name board and one 'Board now' action.
options.risk: Becomes a gimmick if the line motif leaks into every control instead of carrying real progress.

raised.raise: A single 'you are here' marker runs on every surface: the student's live station, the cell's current round, the season's position.
Scale courage: station names set huge against tiny bilingual-style platform labels; hierarchy by size alone.
Active emptiness: the diagram gets real negative space; one line per viewport, never a tangle.
Every control is a station tile on one strict module; active fills solid, idle stays outlined.

options.label: The Attested Record
options.lineage: attested marksheets, university degree certificates, rubber stamps
options.thesis: Every record is a document the cell has checked, sealed and signed.
options.viewport: A giant certificate with guilloche border; 'Verified · Locked' stamped across the hero as the page loads.
options.risk: Close to the cream-paper-and-seal look many runs land on; reads bureaucratic if not lit with energy.

options.label: Placement Data Portraits
options.thesis: The season argued in bold hand-inked charts: spirals of offers, bars of branches.
options.viewport: A crimson spiral of the batch coiling to its placed students, captions lettered by hand.
options.case: Fuses on reports and NIRF numbers; loses on audience identification for students and TPOs.
options.risk: Unreadable as an everyday app if every screen becomes a chart.

options.label: Rhythm Machine Step Row
options.thesis: The season as sixteen steps under a chase light.
options.viewport: Sixteen step keys with a chase light running across the season.
options.case: Fuses poorly: placement officers do not read their year as a beat pattern.

options.label: Variable Type Specimen
options.viewport: One giant glyph morphing under a slider.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nothing in the product is about type.
options.risk: Pure style with no product truth.

options.label: Ikebana Alcove
options.viewport: One branch in a quiet alcove.
options.case: Fuses poorly: foreign to the Indian campus.
options.risk: Too quiet for a busy placement office.

options.label: Hoffmann Gridsmith
options.case: Fuses poorly: luxury showroom, wrong audience.
options.kept: A strict square module for every control.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS placement-portal site: gradient hero, product screenshot, feature grid.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, tilted dashboard screenshot right, logo strip below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Superset and every ERP vendor.
